titleEn: Longest Word in Dictionary through Deleting
title: 通过删除字母匹配到字典里最长单词
summary: 从字典中找能作为给定字符串子序列的最长单词；同长度时返回字典序最小者。
insight: 逐候选双指针检查子序列，并按长度优先、字典序次优的规则维护答案。
pitfalls: 只能删除原字符串字符不能重排
同长度需要选择字典序更小者
不存在时返回空字符串

solutions.title: 逐词子序列验证
solutions.idea: 不必排序字典，在线比较每个合法候选与当前最佳。
steps: 对 word 用双指针判断是否为 s 子序列
合法且更长时替换 best
同长且字典序更小时替换，返回 best

code.java: class Solution { public String findLongestWord(String s,List<String> dictionary){String best="";for(String word:dictionary)if(isSubsequence(word,s)&&(word.length()>best.length()||word.length()==best.length()&&word.compareTo(best)<0))best=word;return best;}private boolean isSubsequence(String word,String s){int index=0;for(int i=0;i<s.length()&&index<word.length();i++)if(s.charAt(i)==word.charAt(index))index++;return index==word.length();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findLongestWord(s:String,dictionary:List<String>):String{fun subsequence(word:String):Boolean{var index=0;for(c in s)if(index<word.length&&word[index]==c)index++;return index==word.length};var best="";for(word in dictionary)if(subsequence(word)&&(word.length>best.length||word.length==best.length&&word<best))best=word;return best} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool subsequence(const string& word,const string& s){int index=0;for(char c:s)if(index<(int)word.size()&&word[index]==c)++index;return index==(int)word.size();}public:string findLongestWord(string s,vector<string>& dictionary){string best;for(string& word:dictionary)if(subsequence(word,s)&&(word.size()>best.size()||word.size()==best.size()&&word<best))best=word;return best;} };
